note: P4146 (Pro 20:24) — a man's steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

dims.v: limited comprehension — man cannot fully understand his own way
the limit of human understanding of one's own way, since a man's steps are directed by the LORD
the bounded human comprehension of a divinely-ordered path

bin (understand) — 'a man's steps are from the LORD; how then can man UNDERSTAND his way?'; since God directs a man's steps, the man cannot fully comprehend his own path. The read holds the humbling limit of self-understanding under divine sovereignty (cf 16:9).
